Lemma
[invariance criterion for closed convex sets] Source: cao-zhu 1. Lemma 2.3.4\group Cao–Zhu Advanced Maximum Principle for Tensors Let $U\subset R^n$ be an open set and $Z\subset U$ be a closed convex subset. Consider the ODE \be \frac{d\varphi }{dt}=N(ϕ,t)\ee where $N:\ U\times [0,T]\rightarrow R^n$ is continuous and Lipschitz in $\varphi $. Then the following two statements are equivalent.

  • For any initial time $t_0\in [0,T]$, any solution of the ODE $(2.3.1)$ which starts in Z at $t_0$ will remain in Z for all later times;

  • $\varphi +N(\varphi ,t)\in T_\varphi Z$ for all $\varphi \in \partial Z$ and $t\in [0,T)$.

Proof

↗ lem:cz-derivative-of-a-fiberwise-supremum ↗ lem:cz-vanishing-from-a-lipschitz-differential-inequality \sketch Use support functionals to identify the tangent-cone condition; the distance to $Z$ then obeys the preceding Lipschitz inequality.
